form.subject: Re: Refund timing for order #4471
form.body:
Dear Maya,

Thank you for your inquiry about the refund for order #4471.

I have checked our system and can confirm that your refund of $249.00 was issued on September 21, 2026 to your original payment method. Refunds typically take 5-7 business days to appear in your account after issuance.

Since today is September 28, 2026, your refund should be arriving shortly if it has not already been processed. Please allow up to 7 business days from the issue date for the funds to be fully credited to your account.

If you have any further questions or do not see the refund by October 2, 2026, please let us know and we will investigate further.

Best regards,
E Corp Support Team
